Bug_Title: MS: Field should be both final and package protected (MS_FINAL_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A mutable static field could be changed by malicious code or
       by accident from another package.
       The field could be made package protected and/or made final
  to avoid
       this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: The 'final' keyword ensures the value of the variable won't change after it is initialized. However, when 'final' is combined with package-protected access, a malicious class or method in another package can still access and modify it.
Trigger_Explanation: The 'final' keyword ensures the value of the variable won't change after it is initialized. However, when 'final' is combined with package-protected access, a malicious class or method in another package can still access and modify it.
